name: Anzai Yuuri
source:
3rd year high school student.
The student council president of the protagonist's school.
She has a strong sense of responsibility and is popular with boys and girls alike.
She's very friendly with [url=/c50933]Ritsu[/url] and there's a rumor going around that they are dating.
